ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Day Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of funds and identify potential shell companies or individuals involved in the day care fraud scheme.
questions: How did the scammers manage to defraud the government of millions of dollars?
What role did state and federal agencies play in allowing the fraud to occur?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale and organized effort to defraud the government, which could lead to significant reforms and accountability. I recommend using data analysis and public records to track the flow of funds and identify key players involved in the scheme.
